Vlaar Enveloppen (historically founded as P. Vlaar in Zaandam in 1926) operated a well-known envelopes and paper-processing plant at Noordervaartdijk 10 in Krommenie, before going bankrupt in 2018. 
Key Details About Vlaar in Krommenie
  • History: Founded in 1926 in Zaandam by Pieter Vlaar as a wholesale business in graphic paper and paper goods, eventually moving into envelope manufacturing and expanding operations. 
  • Location: The historic factory building is located at Noordervaartdijk 10, Krommenie. 
  • Status:
    • Vlaar Enveloppen filed for bankruptcy in 2018, and no restart followed.
    • The industrial building at Noordervaartdijk 10 has a municipal monument status, and the surrounding area (the Vaartdijkterrein / Chromos-Vlaar site) is part of ongoing residential redevelopment plans by the municipality of Zaanstad.
    • The building has occasionally been used for local community events like the Garage Sale Krommenie.
